registered_project_tools.name: propose_mission_revision
registered_project_tools.description: Persist a proposal from a final verified preflight run_id and snapshot hash. Recommendations only; no source edits or simulation. Preserve request_key/proposal_id and review proposal_sha256 before accepting changes.

registered_project_tools.name: get_revision_proposal
registered_project_tools.description: Read a persistent proposal and its reviewed version/hash after reload. view=summary (default) keeps source IDs/hashes, reasons, conditions and consent; view=detail preserves the complete previous response including executor evidence. Both verify the same source-copy integrity. No mission edits, simulation, flight or release of v1 restrictions.

registered_project_tools.name: build_mission_revision
registered_project_tools.description: Build a NEW mission revision from explicitly accepted/operator-supplied changes and the reviewed proposal hash. Physical battery/wind/performance updates require field declarations, labelled operator-declared, not telemetry. Revalidates and exports QGC once; may remain BLOCKED. Never flies or inherits flight consent. Same request_key is idempotent; different inputs conflict.

registered_project_tools.name: start_virtual_preflight
registered_project_tools.description: Admit ONE asynchronous virtual preflight and quickly return run_id and paths. Requires an explicit user rehearsal request: the detached worker may ARM, TAKE OFF and MOVE exclusively simulated v1, then land. Choose and record request_key before calling; it permanently identifies this admission. Validation/acceptance are pending. Never starts simulation. A lost response is recovered with get_virtual_preflight, not another start. PASSED grants neither hardware permission nor another flight.

registered_project_tools.name: get_virtual_preflight
registered_project_tools.description: Read-only preflight lookup by exactly one of run_id or request_key, including historical reports. Use this to query an EXISTING rehearsal by its run_id; a run is not an MCP prompt or generic resource. Returns job state, current/last phase, final result if available, report and paths. Never spawns, resumes, clears v1 ownership or commands flight. view=summary by default; view=detail returns the complete previous response and raw executor evidence. Both retain result/reasons, uncertainty and vehicle restriction. Poll the same run every 15-30 seconds. INTERRUPTED/UNCONFIRMED never implies landing.

registered_project_tools.name: run_virtual_preflight
registered_project_tools.description: SYNCHRONOUS legacy operation: holds the request throughout the rehearsal and may exceed the MCP client timeout without cancelling the backend. Prefer start_virtual_preflight plus get_virtual_preflight for tracking. Run one explicitly requested virtual preflight in Gazebo/ArduPilot SITL. WARNING: this tool ARMS, TAKES OFF and MOVES exclusively simulated vehicle v1, then lands and waits for disarm via the existing executor. It snapshots and hashes the mission, validates safety, checks readiness and compatibility, and persists an evidence report. Never starts/restarts simulation or retries a flight. Use only when the user requests the rehearsal. PASSED does not authorize hardware or grant consent for any subsequent execution.

registered_project_tools.name: update_mission_draft
registered_project_tools.description: Save only operator-supplied mission facts and partial geometry_intent together; no inferred purpose/agriculture, safety limits, height or return decision. Geometry patches merge non-null facts, preserving dimensions; an explicit mode change clears old shape-specific fields. Retain draft_id/draft_revision; geometry edits require current expected_revision, existing routes require replace_route=true. A partial intent saves without waypoints; invalid facts do not overwrite state. Empty updates retrieve. Returns mission/geometry pending fields, effective compatibility defaults and UNVERIFIED field attribution (optional JSON-pointer attributions). Ordinary legacy waypoint updates merge; explicit manual replacement detaches geometry intent. No extra approval for requested saving, and no flight commands.

registered_project_tools.name: get_mission_state
registered_project_tools.description: Read-only mission explanation using exactly one retained draft_id, revision_id or run_id; query an EXISTING preflight run_id here to explain its mission/artifact links, or use get_virtual_preflight for its job/report. No prompt/resource search is needed. NOT a draft inventory. Missing identifier is INVALID_ARGUMENTS, lookup_performed=false, inventory UNKNOWN, never evidence of no drafts. view=summary by default keeps geometry intent/version/count, pending decisions, attribution caveats, defaults, validation and verified links without repeated trees. view=detail returns the complete previous response including route and field provenance. Both perform the same integrity checks. Use retained IDs/detail_access without redundant resource/file exploration. Optional finalization_id selects a draft snapshot. Historical readiness is not current; no consent, validation, writes or operational effects.

registered_project_tools.name: generate_draft_route
registered_project_tools.description: Save/complete structured geometry intent in an existing versioned draft, including incomplete parameters; null/omitted facts preserve earlier dimensions/decisions, explicit mode change resets old shape fields. Return joint geometry/mission pending fields; generate waypoints only when all geometry decisions are explicit. HOME alone is insufficient. Existing routes require replace_route=true for changed geometry; incomplete replacements invalidate old waypoints. Metres, length-edge heading clockwise from north. Deterministic generation is not operator attribution, agriculture or coverage. Optional JSON-pointer attributions are unverified agent declarations. Never flies.

registered_project_tools.name: finalize_mission_draft
registered_project_tools.description: On requested finalization, snapshot the complete draft, validate and export QGC .plan in ONE operation without another saving/validation approval. Pending geometry also blocks finalization. Supply expected_revision; retain finalization_id/mission_path/hashes. Explain this result without repeating validation/export and show compatibility defaults and unverified provenance before seeking rehearsal consent. Unsafe plans remain BLOCKED candidates. Never starts simulation or grants flight consent.

registered_project_tools.name: validate_mission
registered_project_tools.description: Validate a drone mission using the deterministic TFG mission-safety pipeline. No LLM is used for the safety decision.

registered_project_tools.name: validate_and_export_qgc
registered_project_tools.description: Validate a drone mission deterministically and export a QGroundControl .plan file. Unsafe missions remain blocked and are exported only as candidate plans.

registered_project_tools.name: check_simulation_ready
registered_project_tools.description: Check whether the ROS2, Gazebo and ArduPilot simulation stack is healthy and ready. This is a read-only check and does not issue flight commands.

registered_project_tools.name: start_simulation
registered_project_tools.description: Start the deterministic ROS2, Gazebo and ArduPilot simulation stack. This starts the simulation environment only and does not arm, take off or command a vehicle.

registered_project_tools.name: stop_simulation
registered_project_tools.description: Stop the ROS2, Gazebo and ArduPilot simulation processes. This tool is intended for simulation lifecycle management and does not represent a normal in-flight landing command.

registered_project_tools.name: check_mission_execution_ready
registered_project_tools.description: Check whether a mission is authorized for execution. The deterministic mission-safety pipeline must approve the mission and the simulation must be healthy before execution is authorized.

registered_project_tools.name: execute_approved_mission
registered_project_tools.description: SYNCHRONOUS: may exceed the MCP client timeout; timeout does not cancel flight. Shares v1 exclusion with asynchronous preflight. Execute an approved waypoint mission on Drone 1 in the Gazebo/ArduPilot simulation. The executor re-runs the deterministic execution gate internally before issuing any flight command. Unsupported or unsafe missions are blocked. The current executor supports ArduPilot multirotor missions with navigate actions.
